map.质量分数（w = m_溶质 / m_总 × 100%） 使用指南: Mass fraction (w = m_solute / m_total x 100%) guide
map.输入溶质与溶液（或溶剂）的质量，按 w=溶质质量/溶液总质量×100% 计算溶液: Enter the masses of solute and solution (or solvent) and compute the solute mass fraction by w = solute mass / total solution mass x 100%, for solution preparation and concentration accounting.
map.计算溶液中溶质的质量分数。: Compute the mass fraction of the solute in a solution.
map.溶液配制：称盐 10 g 溶于 90 g 水，得 w=10%。: Solution preparation: weigh 10 g of salt and dissolve it in 90 g of water to get w = 10%.
map.化验报告：由称量数据算组分质量分数，填检验报告。: Lab reports: compute each component's mass fraction from weighing data to fill in the inspection report.
map.稀释后复核：稀释前后溶质质量守恒，反算新 w 核对标签。: Dilution check: solute mass is conserved before and after dilution, so back-calculate the new w to verify the label.
map.：输入溶质 5 g、溶液 50 g，工具输出质量分数 w=10.0%，并提示与物: : entering solute 5 g and solution 50 g, the tool outputs a mass fraction w = 10.0% and notes how it differs from molarity.
map.由溶质与溶液质量求质量分数（浓度）: Mass fraction (concentration) from solute and solution mass
map.质量转物质的量（n = m / M）: Mass to amount of substance (n = m / M)
map.不会，溶质质量≤总质量；超了说明称量或定义有误。: No, solute mass is at most the total mass; exceeding it means a weighing or definition error.
map.和物质的量浓度区别？: How does it differ from molarity?
map.质量分数不受体积温度影响，mol/L 受温度体积影响。: Mass fraction is unaffected by volume and temperature, while mol/L is affected by temperature-driven volume change.
map.固体混合物能用吗？: Can it be used for solid mixtures?
map.能，质量分数通用于任何均匀混合物。: Yes, mass fraction applies to any homogeneous mixture.
